description: This file defines the AppState class, a high-level observable singleton managing application state and configuration for a macOS app. It handles user preferences, remote configuration synchronization, voice wake word settings, and app lifecycle actions. The class initializes from stored defaults, manages asynchronous tasks and config watchers, and exposes various properties and methods to control app behavior and settings.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A final class conforming to @Observable, managing the global application state with numerous properties, methods, and async operations for connectivity, preferences, and voice wake configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AppState, loading persisted preferences, applying defaults, setting up config watchers, and starting async tasks for app configuration.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the config watcher when the AppState instance is deallocated.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads configuration from disk and applies overrides to sync app settings with file state.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronized current app config with the external gateway config if any changes occurred.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously enables or disables voice wake functionality, managing permissions and synchronizing with the shared runtime.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously toggles the talk mode, checking permissions and updating remote connection accordingly.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets voice wake triggers globally and avoids redundant syncs.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync of voice wake triggers to the gateway, unless suppressed.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates voice ears for a specified TTL, with cancellation support.

methods.name: blinkOnce
methods.description: Triggers a visual blink by incrementing the blink tick.

methods.name: celebrateSend
methods.description: Triggers a celebration animation by incrementing the send celebration tick.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a VoiceWakeChime from user defaults or provides a fallback.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Encodes and saves a VoiceWakeChime to user defaults.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Applies configuration overrides from a loaded config dictionary to sync app state with config file.

methods.name: updateRemoteTarget
methods.description: Resets the remote target string based on SSH target parsing and hostname.

methods.name: remoteHost
methods.description: Extracts host from a URL string.

methods.name: sanitizeSSHTarget
methods.description: Cleans up SSH target string by removing 'ssh ' prefix.
